about: share.wait (docs/protocol.md → Extensions → share.wait, PROPOSED): negotiated minutes → how long a waiting offer lives. Absent = either side older = 10 minutes. Clamped to [10, 30]. Both ShareOffer.ttlFor (phone) and offerWaitMs (Mac) are tested against this file.

cases.why: either side does not advertise share.wait — exactly today's 10 minutes
a peer cannot shorten the wait below 10 minutes
a lower limit on one side is honoured
never longer than 30 minutes, whatever a peer advertises
